title: Panathinaikos won 2002 Euroleague title
description: Panathinaikos had no mercy for host Kinder Bologna and beat them in the Euroleague Final 89-83. It's a big triumph of Greek team, which won 3rd European top clubs competition in last 7 years. But the game itself was extremely interesting. Just to mention shortly, Panathinaikos was already 13 points down and managed to build up thru the game and get the lead. Panathinaikos Athens - Kinder Bologna 89-83 Panathinaikos will face Kinder in the final - May 3, 2002
